_doc: Rules for findings_fold.py, the no-AI findings sorter (FINDINGS_FOLD_BUILD_QUARRY_SAID_IT_23X; design/RimMandrake/findings_curation_design_2026-10-29.md option B, chosen by the owner by card 2026-10-29: "Program folds, FOUNDRY judges"). It runs as the last step of testq-tick.service (testq.py UNITS), after ingest.py.
_out_why: standing.json (the standing-failures table, every raw text kept) and curation.md (FOUNDRY's daily residue) land here: agent scratch, read by FOUNDRY and the Auditor. The one source of this path; FINDINGS_FOLD_OUT overrides it (selftests)
_live_notes_why: DRY until a fresh blind review is CLEAN (coordinator 2026-10-29, after the blind GPT review v3_review/blind/findings/review.md found 7 P1s): the run computes and writes standing.json and curation.md but writes NO ledger notes (no merges, retirements, routes or contradictions on the ledger). Absent = false (fails safe)
_finding_types_why: the sorter folds what the testq ingest files (type UNTRIAGED, design section 2); hand-filed findings of other types were already judged by the seat that filed them
_lane_item_why: Operations' standing lane item, the one ingest.py already verifies a paused lane against (design section 3, outcome Routed)
_machine_health_patterns_why: routed to Operations, not FOUNDRY: the item says red canaries and machine-health failures go to Operations' lane item; design section 6 names red canaries and refused pulls; a Python module missing on the runner (the PIL fault, design section 2) and a full disk are the test machine's provisioning, not the mod. Case-sensitive regex, searched in the raw text
_retire_after_passes_why: design section 6: a row that has passed 3 later runs in a row is retired with those runs as proof, and reopens when it fails again. A run that is neither PASS nor FAIL (UNMEASURED) breaks the streak: 'in a row' read strictly, so a blind run never helps retire
_contradiction_states_why: design section 6: a failing row under an item marked done or validated is a contradiction and goes to the top of the next curation (the quarry item stood validated with 26 fails and 0 passes)
_stuck_after_days_why: design section 6 step 2: FOUNDRY's residue includes signatures still failing 3 days after they were decided
_decisions_file_why: FOUNDRY's judgment per signature (work / merge / memory / route / retire / undo), appended by `findings_fold.py decide` and committed; a `rimflow spawn --from <finding>` is read from the ledger as a work decision with no line needed
_memory_roots_why: design section 3 and 9.3: memory lands where it is read (a skill, a fact file, a rule or check), never the lessons inbox
_normalise_why: design section 6, narrowed after the blind review (v3_review/blind/findings/review.md findings 1 and 11): only explicitly volatile identifiers are replaced, in this order: testq job ids (with attempt suffix), whole UUIDs (before the hex rule, so a UUID is never half-replaced), compact and ISO timestamps (a file name stamped with its run time keeps its stem: thirst_live_result_<ts>.json), hex ids with at least one digit AND one letter, 7-40 long (git shas, request ids; a pure decimal run such as 0.117750995 is a measured value and stays), RimWorld thing ids (a def name followed by a 4+ digit load id: HemogenPack476708), and testq run numbers. Error codes, assertion values, counts and file names are KEPT: two failures that differ in any of them are two signatures. Words are never removed, so a too-strict rule only makes noise and never merges two bugs
